_comment: Integrity + provenance manifest for the untracked model weights (gitignored *.pt/*.trt/*.onnx/*.npz). Review §9: without this a fresh clone cannot obtain weights. sha256 lets scripts/fetch_weights.py verify a fetched/rebuilt file. .trt/.engine are NOT portable (host-GPU specific) -- rebuild them on-target.
